Pure global connections/labels wrapper groups are omitted during semantic extraction; original business/card and per-edge/per-label groups are retained. Root groups are reparented with explicit original absolute coordinates before the uniform transform.
Original graph/title/tool-count/status source text is retained in doc-guide.json and tools-detail.md; it is not rewritten as currently deployed capability.
